assets.title: The Thorn
assets.content: A small, sharp thorn found near Ezeudu's son's body. It doesn't match any plants growing in that area.

assets.title: The Stone
assets.content: A small, strangely carved stone, smooth and worn, found near the first victim. It feels oddly warm to the touch.

assets.title: The Powder Residue
assets.content: A faint residue of a strange-smelling powder is found on the rim of the Mbaino elder's drinking gourd.

assets.title: The Ceremonial Knife
assets.content: A ceremonial knife, missing a small piece from its blade, found near Ikemefuna's body. The markings on the blade match those used by Umuofia's warriors, but the craftsmanship is slightly different.

assets.title: The Vultures
assets.content: A flock of vultures circles over Okonkwo's compound. This is a sign of impending misfortune.

assets.title: The Burning Barn
assets.content: A player character has a recurring dream of a yam barn being consumed by fire — a symbol of Umuofia's destruction.

assets.title: The Serpent's Skin
assets.content: The python sheds its skin, but the serpent remains. Look to the one who heals, for he also holds the power to harm.

assets.title: The Scales
assets.content: The Earth cries out for balance, the scales tip precariously.

assets.title: The Mbaino Bride
assets.content: I heard Ezeudu's son boasting that he would take another wife from Mbaino. Perhaps they killed him to prevent it!

assets.title: Chielo's Strange Behaviour
assets.content: Some say Chielo has been acting strangely lately, muttering to herself and making pronouncements that don't make sense.

assets.title: Nwoye and Ikemefuna
assets.content: Nwoye has been spending a lot of time with Ikemefuna. The two seem closer every day.

assets.title: Ojiugo and Amadi
assets.content: Ojiugo often seeks out Amadi for herbal remedies, even for minor ailments. They seem to have a close rapport.

assets.title: The Debt
assets.content: Nwakibie has lent a large sum of yams to Okonkwo, and is becoming impatient for repayment.
